description: This file contains utility functions for resolving item details such as notes, notebooks, tags, colors, reminders, and attachments within the Notesnook project. It includes functions for fetching related data from the database, grouping relations, and enriching note data with associated metadata.

methods.name: withDateEdited
methods.description: Calculates the latest date edited or modified among a list of items and returns the items with this date.

methods.name: resolveItems
methods.description: Resolves a list of item IDs to their detailed data, handling notes, notebooks, and tags.

methods.name: resolveNotes
methods.description: Fetches and compiles detailed information for note IDs, including relations to notebooks, tags, colors, reminders, attachments, and lock status.

methods.name: isNoteResolvedData
methods.description: Type guard to check if a data object conforms to the NoteResolvedData structure.
